name: SubmitImageGenerationJob

parameters.help_en:
The type of the generation task. Valid values:

text_to_image: text-to-image.
image_to_image: image-to-image
parameters.help_zh:
生成任务类型
text_to_image，文生图
image_to_image，图生图
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en: The scene. This is an enumeration type. Currently only `general` is supported
parameters.help_zh: 场景，枚举类型，当前仅有 `general`
parameters.name: scene

parameters.help_en:
The task input, in JSON string format. The following fields are included:
Prompt: String. Required. The prompt.
Medias: the media list. Required when the task type is `image_to_image`. A maximum of 9 items are supported.
The Media structure contains: Type, the media type, String, valid value: image; URL, the media download URL, String
parameters.help_zh:
任务输入，Json String，包含：
Prompt，String，必填，提示词
Medias，媒体列表，`image_to_image` 类型时必填，最多9个
Media 结构包含：Type，媒体类型，String，可选 image; URL，媒体下载地址，String
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The task function parameters, in JSON string format. No configuration is required at this time
parameters.help_zh: 任务功能参数，json string，暂不需要设置
parameters.name: job_parameters

parameters.help_en: The aspect ratio. Valid values: 16:9 (default), 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, and 1:1
parameters.name: aspect_ratio

parameters.help_en: The number of images. Valid values: 1 to 4. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 图片数量。取值范围为[1, 4]，默认为1
parameters.name: n

parameters.help_en: The user business data in JSON format
parameters.name: user_data
